theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.pp_one_step :
heckeMultiply 1 0 1 0 = mkState Archimedean.HA_t 1

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.transfer_pp_correct :
Archimedean.transferMatrix 1 0 = Archimedean.T_pp

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.skein_from_markov_traces (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) :
Archimedean.skeinPolynomialCleared config = List.foldl (fun (acc : Archimedean.R_t) (M : Archimedean.TMatrix) => acc * Archimedean.tracedVolCleared M) 1 (Archimedean.buildChains config)

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.optimal_nf_from_transfer_matrix (Z N : ℕ) (h_stable : OptimalNF.valleyOfStability Z N) (h_pos : Z + N ≥ 2) :
(OptimalNF.standardBasis (Z + N - 1)).length = Z + N

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.matrixChain_eq_buildChains (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 < List.length config) :
matrixChain (chainCrossings config j) = (Archimedean.buildChains config).get! j

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.matrixChain_eq_buildChains_axiom (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 < List.length config) [hi : MatrixChainEqBuildChains config j hj] :
matrixChain (chainCrossings config j) = (Archimedean.buildChains config).get! j

instance QOU.TMCorrespondence.instMatrixChainEqBuildChains (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 < List.length config) :
MatrixChainEqBuildChains config j hj

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.matrixChain_eq_buildChains_unconditional (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 < List.length config) :
matrixChain (chainCrossings config j) = (Archimedean.buildChains config).get! j

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.MatrixChainEqBuildChains.eq {config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig} {j : ℕ} (_hj : j + 1 < List.length config) [self : MatrixChainEqBuildChains config j _hj] :
matrixChain (chainCrossings config j) = (Archimedean.buildChains config).get! j

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.buildChains_get (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 < List.length config) :
(Archimedean.buildChains config).get! j = (List.map (fun (nk : Archimedean.NucleonType) => Archimedean.crossingMatrix config[j]! nk) (List.drop (j + 1) config)).prod

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.foldl_take (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (m : ℕ) :
m ≤ List.length config → List.foldl (buildStep config) ([], 0) (List.take m config) = (chainsUpTo config m, m)

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.chainsUpTo_succ (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (m' : ℕ) (h : m' + 1 < List.length config) :
chainsUpTo config (m' + 2) = List.mapIdx (fun (j : ℕ) (Mj : Archimedean.TMatrix) => Mj * Archimedean.crossingMatrix config[j]! config[m' + 1]!) (chainsUpTo config (m' + 1)) ++ [Archimedean.crossingMatrix config[m']! config[m' + 1]!]

List Archimedean.TMatrix

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.take_succ_of_lt (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (m : ℕ) (h : m < List.length config) :
List.take (m + 1) config = List.take m config ++ [config[m]!]

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.mapIdx_map_range {α β : Type} (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) (g : ℕ → α → β) :
List.mapIdx g (List.map f (List.range n)) = List.map (fun (j : ℕ) => g j (f j)) (List.range n)

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.buildChains_eq_foldl (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) :
Archimedean.buildChains config = (List.foldl (buildStep config) ([], 0) config).1

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.matrixChain_chainCrossings (config : Archimedean.NuclearConfig) (j : ℕ) :
matrixChain (chainCrossings config j) = (List.map (fun (nk : Archimedean.NucleonType) => Archimedean.crossingMatrix config[j]! nk) (List.drop (j + 1) config)).prod

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.crossingMatrix_eq (a b : Archimedean.NucleonType) :
Archimedean.crossingMatrix a b = Archimedean.transferMatrix (match Archimedean.vertexType a b with | Archimedean.VertexType.pp => 2 * Archimedean.w_plus_t (Archimedean.vertexType a b) | Archimedean.VertexType.nn => 2 * Archimedean.w_plus_t (Archimedean.vertexType a b) | Archimedean.VertexType.pn => Archimedean.w_plus_t (Archimedean.vertexType a b)) (match Archimedean.vertexType a b with | Archimedean.VertexType.pp => 2 * Archimedean.w_zero_t (Archimedean.vertexType a b) | Archimedean.VertexType.nn => 2 * Archimedean.w_zero_t (Archimedean.vertexType a b) | Archimedean.VertexType.pn => Archimedean.w_zero_t (Archimedean.vertexType a b))

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.smul_transferMatrix (n : ℕ) (c d : Archimedean.R_t) :
n • Archimedean.transferMatrix c d = Archimedean.transferMatrix (↑n * c) (↑n * d)

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.matrixChain_eq_prod (seq : CrossingSeq) :
matrixChain seq = (List.map (fun (cd : Archimedean.R_t × Archimedean.R_t) => Archimedean.transferMatrix cd.1 cd.2) seq).prod

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.matrixChain_eq_reverse_prod (seq : CrossingSeq) :
matrixChain seq = (List.map (fun (cd : Archimedean.R_t × Archimedean.R_t) => Archimedean.transferMatrix cd.1 cd.2) seq).reverse.prod

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.volume_eq_markov_trace (seq : CrossingSeq) :
Archimedean.tracedVolCleared (matrixChain seq) = sigmaCoeff (Matrix.mulVec (matrixChain seq) initialState) + Archimedean.markov_denom * identCoeff (Matrix.mulVec (matrixChain seq) initialState)

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.optimal_coeff_eq_transfer_state (seq : CrossingSeq) :
have state := Matrix.mulVec (matrixChain seq) initialState; sigmaCoeff (heckeChain initialState seq) = sigmaCoeff state ∧ identCoeff (heckeChain initialState seq) = identCoeff state

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.traced_vol_from_state (M : Archimedean.TMatrix) :
Archimedean.tracedVolCleared M = sigmaCoeff (Matrix.mulVec M initialState) + Archimedean.markov_denom * identCoeff (Matrix.mulVec M initialState)

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.markov_trace_eq_traced_vol (a b : Archimedean.R_t) :
a + Archimedean.markov_denom * b = Archimedean.tracedVolCleared !![a, 0; b, 0]

theorem QOU.TMCorrespondence.chain_correspondence (seq : CrossingSeq) (init : StateVec) :
heckeChain init seq = Matrix.mulVec (matrixChain seq) init
